propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB with 92% consumed by reconciler's .bridge_state cache containing bookkeeping fields (baseline_advanced_at, last_get_pass) that are written frequently but read nowhere, causing 12.79 KB marginal pack cost per revision
Deleting baseline_advanced_at and moving last_get_pass to a separate file would reduce marginal pack cost to 1.74 KB per revision and halve version growth once rotation bookkeeping is externalized

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/import pipeline can safely reclaim ~1 GiB from historical .bridge_state versions while preserving all commits, tree identity, and enabling deterministic rollback
The reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub runners so .bridge_state must remain committed to git, and the solution optimizes content and churn rather than relocating the cache off-branch

Post-publication rollback requires explicit quiescence, operator verification of writer pause, epoch mismatch fail-closed enforcement at union sites, and recovery via off-repo backup bundle with writer re-clone

Two consecutive reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state must produce byte-identical bindings.json and create no commit, with marginal pack cost per changed version staying ≤25% of the 12.79 KB baseline
